À 21 ans, Fujio Hayashi s’est porté volontaire pour la toute première opération kamikaze menée par l’armée impériale japonaise pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Toute sa vie, il ne cessera de penser à ces dix-huit mois de guerre qui le hantent. En recueillant ce témoignage, Masa Sawada et Bertrand Bonello tracent le destin d’une personnalité hors du commun.

When he was twenty-one years old, Fujio Hayashi volunteered for the first kamikazi mission carried out by the Japanese Imperial Army during World War Two. For the rest of his life, he would never stop thinking about, or cease to be haunted by these eighteen months of war. By recording his account, Masa Sawada and Bertrand Bonello follow the destiny of a remarkable human being.
